Privacy

Last updated: 13 October 2026. Controller: Freek van Steijn. Contact: fvsteijn@gmail.com

Audiation is a practice app. There is no account. Settings (language, naming, exercise preferences, sound character) stay on your device or browser, not on a server of mine.

The microphone is used only if you turn on sing-or-play or the tuning check. Pitch is measured on the device. Audio is not sent to me.

A wish or change is an email you send yourself (to fvsteijn+audiation-wens@gmail.com). I receive only what you put in that mail. A reply address is optional.

This website is hosted by Cloudflare. Cloudflare may see technical data that comes with any site visit (for example IP address, time, page). I do not use that for profiles or ads on this site.

The free app on Google Play and the App Store shows a short ad before an exercise or tool starts. There is no ad during the exercise itself. A one-time purchase in that store removes the ads. That payment runs through Google or Apple, not through me.

The app is meant from about age 7. Do not include extra personal data about children in a wish.

Questions: fvsteijn@gmail.com

Google (AdMob) may process technical data, such as an advertising ID, to show ads. You can choose in the consent window in the app. This website has no ads.
